title: No retrospective counting
body: Have completed my daily goal at around quarter to midnight. My fitness watch didn’t sync with my phone before the midnight. As a result, my app shows October first goals as not covered, even though the goals were reached by me.  A bit upsetting that the Fitness app doesn’t retrospectively adjusts goal achievements once the day officially is over.
author: BekturS
